Select molecule identifiers and properties for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL5260833. Return columns: molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), molecule_name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records to docs on doc_id. Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5260833'. LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno to include canonical_smiles, allowing nulls when structures are missing. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
